notes.title: NEW DLC Levels FREE!! Best levels yet :) | new "Unlock All Levels" Cheat!
notes.notes:
We wanted to thank everyone who's purchased the game with a free DLC pack of new levels!

I just finished playing through the new levels, and I feel that they've come a long way since 2017.  I think the last level might be the most entertaining level I've ever built. 

Here's an 'in editor' view of the level called 'SPLIT':

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27951863/ddb4ecb3a6422d75c9ba493b768162f742275103.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27951863/c63b0c32284dd5cf81618eab449c0f558a42cb68.png[/img][/url]

Features multiple paths, jumps and deadly fall offs. Super interesting! I actually have no idea which route is the fastest and can't wait to see what times people are posting to the leaderboards!

Some other cool updates include:
[list]
[*] Rejigged the Leaderboard Histgorams to follow more of the PS4 style because I think they looked cooler. Give it a look and let us know what you think!

[*] Added a new 'UNLOCK ALL LEVELS' option in the Settings Menu. Toggle this on and hit confirm, this will unlock all 35 levels.  **Note: This is kinda a cheat, and may screw with unlocking Achievements. If you are super die hard about achievements, maybe don't 'cheat' and unlock the levels.

[*] General engine and graphic optimizations to push the FPS higher and add more fidelity to the graphics. Use the settings menu to adjust the graphics to balance FPS with beautiful looks.

[/list]

Again - Happy December! Thanks for taking the time to try the game, it means a lot to us! 
Please leave any feedback on the forums, and let us know if you want more free DLC and if so, what kind of tracks you guys like playing the most.

ENJOY!
-BRAINCELLS

notes.title: Happy New Years! New FREE DLC!
notes.notes:
Happy New Years!

We would like to thank all the players who have downloaded SUPER AMAZEBALLS and all the amazing feedback we've received. 

Tonight we've released 5 new [u]BONUS[/u] levels that are sure to twist you up! 

This brings the total track count up to 30 Levels!!

These are FREE levels, no need to buy anything extra. Just update the game and they will be added as a 6th page on the Track Menu. You'll need to unlock them like all other tracks-- beat the track before it.   

Good luck!

Oh and speaking of unlocks... we've been discussing adding an option to just unlock all the tracks, but don't know if you guys would like that. Feel free to drop us a comment if you think something like that would be useful!

Happy Gaming
-BRAINCELLS
